outcome: accuracy of 2D sonohysterography (2D SHG) compared to 3D sonohysterography (3D SHG) in evaluating cesarean section uterine scar depth (D), base width (BW), width (W) and residual myometrial thickness (RMT)
cohort: Women with secondary infertility who were candidates for intracytoplasmic sperm injection (ICSI) and had a history of a previous cesarean section
finding: The study found that 3D ultrasound with SHG is superior to 2D ultrasound with SHG in evaluating the residual myometrial thickness (RMT) and niche width prior to ICSI, providing better characterization of the scar niche.
mod_finding: 3D ultrasound with SHG is superior to 2D ultrasound with SHG in evaluating the uterine scar niche after cesarean section.
